messages.content: Call delegate_task exactly once with recipient_address /research-team and description "As the recursively nested research Team coordinator, remain active. Do not call submit_task_result until a later message explicitly requests settlement. Reply exactly APIREV15-NESTED-TASK-TEAM-READY-002 and wait.". Use the field name description. Do not send an ordinary message. After the successful tool result, reply exactly APIREV15-NESTED-TASK-TEAM-READY-002-DELEGATED.
